svg.aria-label: One command: docker compose up --wait starts edge, WAF, bus, database, telemetry and a stub backend. Health checks: Every container has one. CI fails when one service is not healthy in 300 s. WAF test: SQL injection, path traversal and XSS through the edge get 403. A benign request gets 200. No secrets: scripts/init-env.sh writes .env with random dev passwords. .env is git-ignored
